Democracy Defender Mod Manager (DDMM), release candidate 21: *your mods, your democracy, defended.* It's still an
early build, but it's meant to be usable by anyone, not just developers.

**The DDMM Promise, in brief:** every mod is welcome (DDMM never blocks, blacklists or ranks mods or mod sites),
no account is ever needed on any site, your files stay in a folder you control, it's Apache-2.0 open source
forever, and update checks never run unless you ask.

## Quick start

1. **Download** the right file for you (see the table below).
2. **Run it.** DDMM looks for your Helldivers 2 install automatically. If Steam is in its usual place, there's
   nothing to set up.
3. **Add mods and click Deploy.** Drag in an archive or folder, or click "Add URL" and paste a link.

**Works with AyakaMods, Nexus Mods, ModWorkshop, GameBanana, GitHub, any direct link, or files already on your
disk.** Special love to the AyakaMods community ❤️, one of the best homes for Helldivers 2 modding. Go say hi:
<https://ayakamods.com/games/helldivers-2.119/>.

## Which file do I download?

| You want... | Download |
| --- | --- |
| A normal install on Windows (Start Menu shortcut, uninstaller) | `DDMM-2.0.0-rc.21-windows-x64-setup.exe` |
| Windows without installing anything (unzip and run) | `DDMM-2.0.0-rc.21-windows-x64-portable.zip` |
| Linux: Fedora, Nobara, openSUSE (`dnf`/`zypper`) | `DDMM-2.0.0-rc.21-linux-x86_64.rpm` |
| Linux: Debian, Ubuntu, Mint (`apt`) | `DDMM-2.0.0-rc.21-linux-amd64.deb` |
| Linux: other distros, no install (uses your desktop's graphics libraries) | `DDMM-2.0.0-rc.21-linux-x86_64.AppImage` |
| Linux: Arch/CachyOS, or just the binary (needs WebKitGTK 4.1) | `DDMM-2.0.0-rc.21-linux-x64.tar.gz` |

Linux install commands, the dependencies for each distro, and fixes for a blank window or AppImage/FUSE errors
are in [Installing on Linux](https://katsyk.github.io/DemocracyDefenderModManager/getting-started/linux/).

**One-click install (optional):** also grab the browser extension: `ddmm-extension-chrome-1.0.1.zip`
(Chrome, Edge, Brave) or `ddmm-extension-firefox-1.0.1.zip` (Firefox). See
[One-click install](https://katsyk.github.io/DemocracyDefenderModManager/using/one-click-install/).

Check `SHA256SUMS.txt` if you want to verify your download.

## What's new in 2.0.0-rc.21

### A popup after startup recovery

When DDMM is closed or crashes in the middle of something, it sorts that out the next time it starts. Until now,
what it did went only to the log. Now, if it changed something or found something it can't sort out on its own,
the Mods page says so once, in a single *When DDMM Started* popup.

- **What it can list:** an update finished, or undone so the mod keeps the version it had; a set-aside version
  put back under another folder name; options reset to the defaults in some profiles; profiles.json that couldn't
  be saved (DDMM tries again on the next start); hidden leftover folders DDMM left as they are; and a mod that isn't
  listed because its manifest.json can't be read.
- **Open Folder** is shown next to items with a folder to deal with. **OK** or Escape closes the popup.
- **Problems that are still there,** such as a hidden folder you haven't dealt with yet, are listed again on
  every start until they're resolved, but only once per session.
- DDMM only deletes leftovers it knows are its own copies. Anything that may be your only copy is left for you to
  check, and nothing is deleted.

See [A popup when DDMM starts](https://katsyk.github.io/DemocracyDefenderModManager/help/troubleshooting/#a-popup-when-ddmm-starts).

### Deploy crash safety

DDMM now writes down which files it will deploy before copying them. If DDMM is closed or crashes partway through a
deploy, no mod file is left in the game without a record, and the next Purge or Deploy removes every file the
stopped deploy wrote.

- **It checks that the record can be written before removing anything.** If it can't (for example, the game's
  `data` folder is read-only), the deploy stops with nothing changed, and the mods you deployed before stay in
  place.
- **If the final record can't be saved** after copying, the error is shown. Your mods are in place, and Purge
  still removes them.
- **Skip List files from a stopped deploy** are removed only if they match the mod's file (possibly cut short where
  the copy stopped). A game file that Steam put back is kept. If the mod's own file is gone, DDMM keeps its copy,
  since it can no longer check it.

See [Deploy & purge](https://katsyk.github.io/DemocracyDefenderModManager/using/deploy-purge/) and
[DDMM closed or crashed while deploying](https://katsyk.github.io/DemocracyDefenderModManager/help/troubleshooting/#ddmm-closed-or-crashed-while-deploying).

### Fixes from dependency updates

- **Windows drag-and-drop:** files dropped from Explorer are now accepted when a path is 260 characters or longer.
- **A second launch no longer hangs on Windows:** a second DDMM (for example from a `ddmm://` link) no longer waits
  forever on a stuck first one. It gives up after 10 seconds.
- **Deep-link registration on Linux** (AppImage) no longer fails when `update-desktop-database` is missing.
- **Windows installer:** installing over an existing install no longer leaves the old `uninstall.exe` and install
  folder behind.
- **Fixed a crash** in the app's internal file handling when a request had an empty path.
- **Updated libraries and build tools.** Changing the data folder needed one small change so that DDMM still
  restarts afterwards with the new library versions.

### If you're coming from rc.14 or earlier

If you used the Skip List with rc.14 or earlier, verify the game files in Steam once (Library → Helldivers 2 →
Properties → Installed Files → Verify integrity of game files). Older versions could delete the game's own files
for those names.

**Skipped a few?** rc.10 had important safety fixes, rc.11 fixed mod deletion, rc.12 fixed mod option dropdowns, rc.13 fixed AyakaMods update checks, rc.14 fixed the Mods page stuck on "Loading...", rc.15 fixed Deploy and Purge removing mods and game files, rc.16 added Replace for mods with the same ID, rc.17 was a security update for archive extraction, rc.18 fixed a rare memory bug on Linux, rc.19 added Move to Top/Bottom by priority, Escape for popups and Replace in Import and rc.20 added crash safety for updates and Replace; see the [releases page](https://github.com/katsyk/DemocracyDefenderModManager/releases).

Thanks to everyone testing the release candidates. o7

## Known limitations

- **Windows builds are unsigned.** Windows SmartScreen will likely show a warning the first time you run the
  installer or the app. Click **"More info" → "Run anyway"** to continue.
- **The Linux .rpm and .deb are unsigned**, so openSUSE needs `zypper install --allow-unsigned-rpm`.
- **Changing the data folder** (which restarts DDMM) was reviewed, but hasn't been tested on a real Windows PC yet.
  If DDMM doesn't come back up after you change it, please report it.
- **This is still a release candidate.** Expect some rough edges, and please report what you find.
